canonical_session_authority.principle: a bar's session MUST be derived from ts_utc via the CT+calendar authority, NEVER from stored et_hour/et_minute/market_session (those were EST-fixed for rows before COH_I_A_ET_AUTHORITY_TS_UTC=1779237069.0 and are DST-skewed)
